summary: Tested 3 new columns (Active Streak, Longest Streak, Dynasty Arc SVG) on LeagueHistory Lifetime Records tab. Discovered and FIXED a critical runtime crash bug ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading push)'). After fix, all required behavior verified: 14 columns render, streak badges show real values including 7W and 7L, Arc SVGs with trailing trend indicators present, multi-line tooltips via title attribute, and legend chips for trending up/down. All iter51-53 regression testids still work.
action_items: Verify the fix I applied: added `seasonRows: []` to the tally object initialization in LeagueHistory.tsx ensure() function (line ~165). Without this, the page crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading push)' the moment r.seasonRows.push(...) was called at line 190.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (fixed): LeagueHistory.tsx — `ensure()` factory did not initialize `seasonRows: []`, causing a crash on first push. The new computeStreaks/DynastyArc code reads/writes this array, so initialization was mandatory. Without my fix, the entire /league-history route showed an Uncaught runtime error overlay and the lifetime-records-table never rendered.
Suggestion: consider extracting the lifetime-records computation (currently ~130 lines inside useMemo) into a separate helper module — the file is 750 lines and the tally builder is hard to read.

Suggestion: the live current-season detection comment in lines 224-230 admits the heuristic is best-effort (`snapshotYears.has(-1)` is always false, so `currentYearOpen` is effectively `!!leagueTeams?.length`). Confirm this is intentional, otherwise current-year double-count remains a risk after a snapshot is created.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing synthetic 7-season snapshots — Blue Line Bruisers shows 7W active+longest, another team shows 7L)
context_for_next_testing_agent: LeagueHistory Lifetime Records tab has 14 columns now: Rank, Team, Seasons, W, L, Win %, Total Pts, Active Streak, Longest Streak, Arc, Championship, President's Trophy, Division Win, Conference Win. Streak badges are e.g. '7W' on green border, '7L' on red border. Arc is a 60x16 inline SVG with title= multi-line tooltip and a trailing ▲/▼/— glyph at [data-testid=lifetime-arc-{teamId}-trend]. Legend chips for trending up/down are between the All-Time Team Standings header and the table. The recent-crowns card uses data-testid=league-history-recent-crowns. The Trophy Room view has its own tab (league-history-trophy-room only renders when that tab is active).
rca of the issue: RCA: The new computeStreaks/DynastyArc code pushes per-season rows into `r.seasonRows` (LeagueHistory.tsx:190, 245) but the `ensure()` factory at line 151-165 created the tally object without an initial `seasonRows: []` field. Repro: log in → /league-history → Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push') at LeagueHistory useMemo. Mitigation applied: added `seasonRows: [],` to the initial tally object. After fix, all 12 teams render with their per-season arrays correctly aggregated.
